description: Test cases for metodologia-release-strategy — happy path, edge case, failure.

evals.name: happy-path-standard-invocation
evals.prompt: Apply the `release-strategy` skill for AcmeCorp (LatAm retail client, 200 users). Generate the standard deliverable.
evals.expected_output: Complete release strategy deliverable with standard sections, evidence tags, and ghost menu.
assertions: Output has ghost menu or next-step recommendation

evals.name: edge-case-incomplete-context
evals.prompt: Apply `release-strategy` with incomplete context: I only have the client name and nothing else. How do you proceed?
evals.expected_output: Skill detects [VACIO_CRITICO] and requests minimum inputs before proceeding.
assertions: Output requests clarifying questions BEFORE proceeding

evals.name: failure-no-validated-source
evals.prompt: Apply `release-strategy` for a client where I have no validated information. Don't fabricate.
evals.expected_output: Skill responds with [SUPUESTO] tags and validation banner; no fabrication.
assertions: Output uses [SUPUESTO] or refuses with banner
Output explicitly notes data needs validation
Output does NOT proceed with fabricated facts
